mechanics.quote: '''Mel''' forms a protective barrier around herself for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, granting herself a {{tip|shield}} for the duration

mechanics.claim: All hostile projectiles from enemy champions that collide with the barrier are destroyed and replicated by Mel toward or in the direction of the original source (or toward herself for healing projectiles).
mechanics.quote: all hostile {{tip|projectiles}} sourced from enemy {{tip|champions}} that collide with the barrier will be destroyed instantly before '''Mel''' fires the same projectiles as her own, either toward or in the direction of the {{tt|original sources|See notes}}, or {{tt|toward herself|See notes}}

mechanics.claim: Replicated projectiles convert all their damage to magic damage, with physical damage instances reduced to 70% before conversion.
mechanics.quote: all of their damage is converted to {{as|magic damage}}, with {{as|physical damage}} instances being reduced to 70% before conversion

mechanics.claim: The damage of the replicated missile scales only with Mel's own damage modifiers and magic penetration, not the original source's stats, even though other properties use the original source's attributes.
mechanics.quote: The damage of the missile only benefits from '''Mel's''' [[damage modifier]]s and [[magic penetration]], and not the original source's.
